title_sq: SHITET AMBIENT KOMERCIAL TE KOMPLEKSI HALILI
description_sq:
Shitet ambient komercial te Kompleksi Halili me nje siperfaqe neto prej 256 m2. I ndare ne 8 ambiente pune (zyra), dy tualete. Ambienti ndodhet ne katin e 5 (peste) teknik eshte totalishti investuar me parket, me sitem Chiller me uje dhe kondicioner kollone, sistem ndricimi, sistem kamera, rjet interneti kuzhine e dedikuar per stafin, fasade xhami dhe me hyrje te dedikuar si dhe dy ashensore ne perdorim. Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!!
title_en: COMMERCIAL ENVIRONMENT FOR SALE IN HALILI COMPLEX
description_en: Commercial premises in the Halili Complex with a net area of ​​256 m2 are for sale. Divided into 8 work spaces (offices), two toilets. The environment is located on the 5th (fifth) technical floor, it is totally invested with parquet, with water chiller system and column air conditioner, lighting system, camera system, Internet network, dedicated kitchen for the staff, glass facade and dedicated entrance as well as two elevators in use. Parking is possible. At the moment it is rented for 2500 euros gross (per month). For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!!
